items.name: Garyville feedstock optimization project
items.claim: Marathon Petroleum's newly announced Garyville feedstock optimization project is budgeted at $110 million of 2026 capital spend and another $185 million in 2027, targeted for completion by year-end 2027.
items.source_excerpt: Newly Announced Garyville - Feedstock Optimization: To optimize feedstock slate by displacing higher-cost intermediate purchases with crude to improve margin. Capital spend in 2026 is expected to be $110 million and another $185 million in 2027. Completion is expected by year-end 2027.

items.name: MPLX BANGL Pipeline expansion
items.claim: MPLX's BANGL Pipeline is being expanded from 250 mbpd to 300 mbpd capacity, supporting Gulf Coast fractionators, expected in service in Q4 2026.
items.source_excerpt: BANGL Pipeline: Expansion from 250 mbpd to 300 mbpd; supporting MPLX's Gulf Coast fractionators. Expected in service in the fourth quarter of 2026.

notes: Q4/FY2025 results release names a slate of refining and MPLX midstream capital projects; excerpted the two with explicit dollar or capacity figures.
